ui.setupHelp:
1. In NinjaOne go to **Administration > Apps > API**, then **Add** a client app (top right).
2. Application platform: **API Services (machine-to-machine)**. Name: `conduit-mcp`.
3. Scopes: tick **monitoring**, **management** and **control**.
4. Allowed grant types: **Client Credentials**, then save.
5. Copy the client ID and secret into the fields below.
6. The OAuth scope field below defaults to `monitoring`. Set it to `monitoring management control` to request everything the app grants.

settings.label: Base URL
settings.help: Region instance, e.g. https://app.ninjarmm.com, https://eu.ninjarmm.com, https://oc.ninjarmm.com

settings.label: Client ID
settings.help: Client ID of a machine-to-machine API application (Administration -> Apps -> API)

settings.label: Client secret
settings.help: Client secret of the same API application
